definitions.explanation: The most important Buddhist memorial service, held 49 days after death. Believed to be when the deceased's fate in the afterlife is determined.

examples.japanese: {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{喪|も}→喪：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{服|ふく}す→服す：29104_fukusu⟧。
examples.english: We observe mourning until the 49th day has passed.

examples.japanese: {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Relatives gathered for the 49th day memorial service.

examples.japanese: {四十九日|しじゅうくにち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦{忌明|きあ}け→忌明け：29105_kiake⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The mourning period ends when the 49th day arrives.

notes:
In Buddhist belief, the soul undergoes judgment every seven days for 49 days, after which its next rebirth is determined.

KEY CONCEPTS:
- ⟦{忌明|きあ}け→忌明け：29105_kiake⟧: end of mourning period (after 49 days)
- ⟦{中陰|ちゅういん}→中陰：noentry⟧: the 49-day period between death and rebirth
- ⟦{香典返|こうでんがえ}し→香典返し：18917_koudengaeshi⟧: return gifts sent after the 49th day

CUSTOMS:
- ⟦{仮祭壇|かりさいだん}→仮祭壇：noentry⟧ (temporary altar) is removed
- ⟦{本位牌|ほんいはい}→本位牌：noentry⟧ (permanent memorial tablet) replaces temporary one
- Mourning restrictions on celebration end
